The question was why the barcode does not show when a gift card is issued. The barcode was being made. It is on the printed card and in the text to the guest. The problem was where the screen showed it.

The barcode sat inside the card list on the right, and only after you opened Barcode and history. On a wide screen the list is beside the form. On a tablet or laptop narrower than 1280 pixels, the list drops below the form, so after issuing, the barcode was off the screen.

Now, right after issuing, a Just issued box under the form shows that card's barcode, with the card number and the value, and a Reprint button. It sits right under the Issue button at any screen width.

The amount buttons changed too. They used to replace the amount. Now each tap adds to it. Fifty, fifty, then twenty-five makes one hundred twenty-five dollars. Clear empties it if you tap the wrong one, and you can still type an amount.

One file changed, the admin gift cards page. It has no lint or type errors. It has not been clicked through in a browser yet, and it is not committed or deployed. After deploying, please check it with one card.
